# bronto_metric_definition (Resource)

Manages a Bronto metric definition.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "bronto_metric_definition" "api_response_time" {
  name        = "api_response_time"
  description = "Tracks response time for API endpoints in production"

  queries = [
    {
      name      = "production_api_response_time"
      select    = ["response_time_ms"]
      from_expr = "environment = 'production' AND service = 'api-gateway'"
      where     = "endpoint LIKE '/api/v1/%' AND response_time_ms > 0"
      groups    = ["endpoint", "method"]

      aggregation = {
        time      = "avg"
        reduce_to = "avg"
      }
    }
  ]

  # Optional: combine the queries above into a derived value.
  formulas = [
    {
      name       = "response_time_seconds"
      expression = "production_api_response_time / 1000"
    }
  ]
}

# The resulting metric definition ID can be referenced from a widget.
resource "bronto_widget" "api_response_time" {
  name       = "API response time"
  type       = "line"
  metric_ids = [bronto_metric_definition.api_response_time.id]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `queries` (Attributes List) The list of simple queries to be computed. The result can be referenced in formulas. A metric definition cannot be updated in place: changing this list replaces the resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--queries))

### Optional

- `description` (String) An optional description for this metric definition
- `formulas` (Attributes List) A list of formulas to combine the queries results. A metric definition cannot be updated in place: changing this list replaces the resource. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--formulas))
- `name` (String) An optional name for the metric definition

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier for the metric definition

<a id="nestedatt--queries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `queries`

Required:

- `name` (String) The unique name of the query within the metric definition. Cannot contain spaces if the query is referenced in a formula.
- `select` (List of String) The single metric field to retrieve from the dataset.
- `where` (String) Filters the results of the query. Can combine multiple terms using AND, OR, NOT.

Optional:

- `aggregation` (Attributes) The aggregation to apply to the selected metric field. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--queries--aggregation))
- `from` (List of String) Log IDs to query. Exactly one of `from` or `from_expr` must be specified.
- `from_expr` (String) An expression identifying the logs or metric to query. Exactly one of `from` or `from_expr` must be specified.
- `groups` (List of String) Keys used to arrange the aggregated results into groups.
- `unit_config` (String) Optional configuration describing the unit of the query's raw value, as a JSON-encoded string (e.g. `jsonencode({...})`). Used for UI display only.

<a id="nestedatt--queries--aggregation"></a>
### Nested Schema for `queries.aggregation`

Required:

- `time` (String) The time-bucket aggregation function.

Optional:

- `reduce_to` (String) The final reduction applied to the aggregated result. Defaults to `avg`.
- `time_function_params` (List of String) Parameters for the time function.



<a id="nestedatt--formulas"></a>
### Nested Schema for `formulas`

Required:

- `expression` (String) The expression that defines the formula. Formula elements refer, by name, to queries defined in this metric definition.
- `name` (String) The unique name, within the metric definition, of the formula.

Optional:

- `reduce_to` (String) The reduction to apply to the timeseries to reduce it to a single value. Defaults to `avg`.
- `unit_config` (String) Optional configuration describing the unit of the formula's value, as a JSON-encoded string (e.g. `jsonencode({...})`). Used for UI display only.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Metric definitions can be imported by their unique ID.
terraform import bronto_metric_definition.api_response_time 41521f35-1b06-41f0-9cdc-9a938b5739d1
```
